memories.content: The Chair is responsible for scheduling committee business. They are aware of the sixty-day window for scheduling a public hearing on the rail franchise bill. They have their own political considerations and workload priorities.

The Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee has received the rail franchise bill. Committee rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The bill is currently pending before the committee. The committee can schedule hearings at its discretion within that window.
